from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # The most common row and column profiles are the regular, unmarked
    # parts of the repeating lattice.
    regular_row = list(Counter(tuple(row) for row in grid).most_common(1)[0][0])
    row_bg = Counter(regular_row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    node_cols = [c for c, value in enumerate(regular_row) if value != row_bg]

    regular_col = list(Counter(
        tuple(grid[r][c] for r in range(h)) for c in range(w)
    ).most_common(1)[0][0])
    col_bg = Counter(regular_col).most_common(1)[0][0]
    node_rows = [r for r, value in enumerate(regular_col) if value != col_bg]

    out = []
    for i in range(len(node_rows) - 1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(node_cols) - 1):
            a = grid[node_rows[i]][node_cols[j]]
            b = grid[node_rows[i]][node_cols[j + 1]]
            c = grid[node_rows[i + 1]][node_cols[j]]
            d = grid[node_rows[i + 1]][node_cols[j + 1]]
            row.append(a if a == b == c == d else 9)
        out.append(row)
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    def find_lines(profile):
        best = None
        n = len(profile)
        for period in range(2, min(10, n - 1) + 1):
            for phase in range(period):
                selected = [i for i in range(n) if i % period == phase]
                other = [i for i in range(n) if i % period != phase]
                if len(selected) < 3 or len(other) < 2:
                    continue
                a = sum(profile[i] for i in selected) / len(selected)
                b = sum(profile[i] for i in other) / len(other)
                score = abs(a - b)
                candidate = (score, -period, selected)
                if best is None or candidate[:2] > best[:2]:
                    best = candidate
        return best[2] if best else []

    rows = find_lines([sum(v == 1 for v in row) for row in grid])
    cols = find_lines([sum(grid[r][c] == 1 for r in range(h)) for c in range(w)])

    out = []
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        out_row = []
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            corners = (
                grid[rows[i]][cols[j]],
                grid[rows[i]][cols[j + 1]],
                grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j]],
                grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j + 1]],
            )
            out_row.append(corners[0] if all(x == corners[0] for x in corners) else 9)
        out.append(out_row)
    return out

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Separator rows and columns are dominated by the grid's separator color.
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r].count(9) > w // 2]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == 9 for r in range(h)) > h // 2]

    # The ordinary color inside the lattice cells.
    interior = Counter(
        grid[r][c]
        for r in range(h) if r not in rows
        for c in range(w) if c not in cols
    ).most_common(1)[0][0]

    out = []
    for r0, r1 in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
        line = []
        for c0, c1 in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
            corners = [
                grid[r0][c0], grid[r0][c1],
                grid[r1][c0], grid[r1][c1]
            ]
            line.append(corners[0] if all(x == corners[0] for x in corners) else interior)
        out.append(line)
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    common = {v for v, _ in Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(2)}

    rows = [r for r in range(h) if any(v not in common for v in grid[r])]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] not in common for r in range(h))]

    interior = Counter(
        grid[r][c]
        for r in range(h) if r not in rows
        for c in range(w) if c not in cols
    ).most_common(1)[0][0]

    out = []
    for r0, r1 in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
        line = []
        for c0, c1 in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
            a = grid[r0][c0]
            if (grid[r0][c1] == a and grid[r1][c0] == a
                    and grid[r1][c1] == a):
                line.append(a)
            else:
                line.append(interior)
        out.append(line)
